title.en: See the gaps, then fill them

hints.tr: `count()` **dolu** hücreleri, `size` hepsini sayıyor. İkisi farklıysa eksik var demektir.
hints.en: `count()` counts the **filled** cells and `size` counts all of them. If they differ, something is missing.

hints.tr: pandas ortalamayı alırken eksikleri kendiliğinden atlıyor — `nanmean` gibi bir şeye gerek yok. Doldurmak için `fillna(average)`.
hints.en: pandas skips the missing ones when taking the mean by itself — you do not need anything like `nanmean`. To fill, use `fillna(average)`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
missing = temps.isna().sum()
average = temps.mean()
filled = temps.fillna(average)

print(missing)
print(temps.count(), temps.size)
print(round(average, 2))
print(filled.tolist())
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
missing = temps.isna().sum()
average = temps.mean()
filled = temps.fillna(average)

print(missing)
print(temps.count(), temps.size)
print(round(average, 2))
print(filled.tolist())
```

hint.en: There is no `import pandas as pd` line.
